capabilities.title: Runtime: single Bun HTTP process, Effect services, scoped watcher
capabilities.expectation: Execution test target maps service ownership; parity claims come from behavior tests, not this documentation.

capabilities.title: Bind 127.0.0.1:8791 default; tailnet bind; reject public/wildcard
capabilities.expectation: Default bind 127.0.0.1; strict IpAddr parse; correction C10 narrows tailnet to 100.64.0.0/10 + fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48 and forbids wildcard/public; port strict 1..65535.

capabilities.title: Herdr startup ping; Herdr unavailable = warning, HTTP stays up
capabilities.expectation: Ping result drives health warning only; backend must serve even when Herdr is unreachable.

capabilities.title: Polling watcher starts with service; SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown
capabilities.expectation: Watcher lifecycle owns no process outside its own; shutdown stops watcher, poller, subscriptions; no user agent touched.

capabilities.title: Compiled PWA served relative to server source location
capabilities.expectation: Assets embedded at build time; binary serves from any cwd; no arbitrary disk path exposure.

capabilities.title: Static traversal/symlink confinement; SPA fallback; JSON 503 if build absent
capabilities.expectation: Bad encoding/escapes/missing assets fall back to index; missing build yields JSON 503 {error,hint}; unknown /api stays JSON 404 (C08).

capabilities.title: no-cache/no-store for index, worker, manifest; API JSON no-store
capabilities.expectation: Headers retained: index/sw.js/push-sw.js/manifest + fallback HTML no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate; API JSON no-store.

capabilities.title: herdrchat launcher + release tarball with built PWA and sources
capabilities.expectation: Native release path: herdrchat binary with embedded PWA; no Bun/Node requirement; archives/checksums prepared at T066.

capabilities.title: Homebrew service + Tailscale Serve documented deployment
capabilities.expectation: Service integration retained conceptually; tap/service changes remain separate deployment work requiring explicit user instruction.

capabilities.title: verify = format, lint, typecheck, tests; pre-commit + tag release
capabilities.expectation: Rust gates (fmt/clippy/test/layout/coverage) compose with TS gates during transition; xtask verify enforces them.

capabilities.title: Supported session families
capabilities.expectation: Pi, Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Devin readable; installed ≠ readable; Cursor catalog support ≠ Cursor session reader.

capabilities.title: Source reference resolution
capabilities.expectation: path uses advertised file; Codex/Claude IDs search JSONL filenames; opencode/Devin IDs select read-only SQLite stores; empty IDs refused.

capabilities.title: Codex missing-reference fallback
capabilities.expectation: Title 'name | cwd-basename'; versioned state_*.sqlite threads by exact name+cwd, unarchived, latest update; rollout file must exist; C15 numeric version order.

capabilities.title: Header reads
capabilities.expectation: Bounded 64 KiB first line; cwd/id/parentSession/version; version fallback 1; header failure currently ignored by enrichment (documented).

capabilities.title: JSONL reading
capabilities.expectation: Header, full/forward/tail/backward, file-size identity, partial trailing records, unknown entries preserved; never write source files; C02 offset convention.

capabilities.title: Pi compatibility
capabilities.expectation: Original JSONL retained; 8 message roles; settings/usage/context/compaction/custom entries; parentId = conversation ancestry, parentSession = session lineage.

capabilities.title: Codex normalization
capabilities.expectation: response_item messages/function/custom tools/results/redacted reasoning; event_msg.item_completed kinds; command outcome/diff; settings turn_context/thread_settings_applied; long prompts preserved; encrypted reasoning never invented.

capabilities.title: Codex context filtering
capabilities.expectation: Exclude developer/system prose and user content entirely made of injected AGENTS.md/INSTRUCTIONS/environment context; no size heuristic.

capabilities.title: Claude normalization
capabilities.expectation: user/assistant lines; text and tool_use/tool_result incl. error; model from message; slash-command XML decoded; app notices/interrupt/compaction/system wrappers excluded; refused lines stripped before raw fallback.

capabilities.title: opencode normalization
capabilities.expectation: user text; assistant text, clear reasoning, tool calls/results/error/images, data-URI images; model.id/providerID/variant; default variant omitted; unsupported row types remain raw.

capabilities.title: Devin normalization
capabilities.expectation: user/assistant text and clear thinking; metadata.created_at/generation_model; system excluded; OpenAI-like tool conversion guarded — real tool-call shape unmeasured and stays marked unverified.

capabilities.title: SQLite paging
capabilities.expectation: opencode session_v2/session_message by seq; Devin sessions/message_nodes by row_id; latest ascending after reverse; inclusive boundary replay; backward cursor; read-only queries; 3 s busy timeout.

capabilities.title: Conversation summary
capabilities.expectation: One row per visible agent pane; last user text, assistant text or last tool+argument preview; known timestamp; model/provider/thinking; branch; source availability/cause; optional question/trust/waiting.

capabilities.title: Summary cache
capabilities.expectation: File identity+size/offset+pending; 256 entries oldest eviction; 64 KiB tail; up to 32 older windows (~2 MiB); incremental update preserves prior metadata unless replaced.

capabilities.title: Summary isolation
capabilities.expectation: Four concurrent session reads; one bad session keeps other lines; snapshot failure = aggregate failure; question-screen enrichment measured per line.

capabilities.title: Git branch metadata
capabilities.expectation: git -C <cwd> rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; 3 s timeout; 30 s cache; detached/empty/missing git/error = absent branch; one job per cwd.

capabilities.title: Conservative metadata
capabilities.expectation: Placeholder models in angle brackets excluded; model/provider selected as pair; timestamps never fabricated; summaries are extracted data, no LLM generation.

capabilities.title: Submit prompt
capabilities.expectation: Read current status; ordinary path agent.prompt; blocked path literal text then Enter; specific interactive-input refusal triggers same fallback; never on timeout/unknown state.

capabilities.title: Local duplicate suppression
capabilities.expectation: SHA256(target + NUL + text)[:32hex]; 60 s window; correction C06: last-confirmed per-pane semantics, concurrency serialized; A→B→A allowed; unknown/unconfirmed never suppresses.

capabilities.title: Action uncertainty treatment
capabilities.expectation: Ordinary protocol success confirmed only when discriminator matches (C05); literal-input path unknown; transport failures classified timeout/refusal/unknown.

capabilities.title: Stop working agent
capabilities.expectation: Fresh snapshot; absent → 404; nonworking no-op; working sends Ctrl+C via Herdr; interrupt-sent is not termination proof.

capabilities.title: Focus/acknowledgement
capabilities.expectation: agent.focus real desktop effect; focused boolean, failure as 200 value; logged explicitly.

capabilities.title: Installed integrations
capabilities.expectation: integration.list; mapping command vs target; readable-family filter; launch excludes state not_installed.

capabilities.title: Explicit agent launch
capabilities.expectation: Workspace validation/cwd; unique generated <label>-1..99 name or provided; new unfocused tab; root pane; start agent with model args; no automatic second agent.

capabilities.title: Shell readiness and launch failure
capabilities.expectation: Retry only explicit 'not an available shell' refusal; 3 s spacing ×10; 120 s upstream detection; start deadline 125 s; overall 160 s; close only owned tab on validation failure; blocked pane retained for trust; C07.

capabilities.title: Trust detection / response
capabilities.expectation: Actual screen marker required; kind-specific keys (Codex accept [1,enter]/deny [2]; Claude accept [down,enter]/deny [enter]); no fallback for unknown kind.

capabilities.title: Trust verification
capabilities.expectation: Read before; send keys; verify agent existence; reread; disappeared/persistent prompt ⇒ transmise; refusal may quit agent; no config editing.

capabilities.title: Question parser
capabilities.expectation: Last coherent numbered list from 1, ≥2 choices; selected › marker; same-line/two-space/indented detail; gutters stripped; context + Enter/arrow help parsed.

capabilities.title: Answer question
capabilities.expectation: Fresh visible screen; offered integer choice only; number+Enter; optional trimmed free text+Enter; reread distinguishes remaining/disappearing; unreadable question → refusee value.

capabilities.title: Model catalog lookup
capabilities.expectation: Five adapters; successful-result 60 s cache + in-flight reuse; provenance + explicit unavailable reason; no catalog from installed family.

capabilities.title: Launch model/level args
capabilities.expectation: Pi --model/--thinking; Claude --model/--effort (effort-only allowed); Codex -m/--config model_reasoning_effort; Cursor --model (thinking rejected); others reject overrides.

capabilities.title: Model-level validation
capabilities.expectation: Validate declared levels only when model+thinking supplied; absent model/catalog levels do not establish unsupported; absent requested model = no invented default.

capabilities.title: Polling state watcher
capabilities.expectation: 2 s after completed iteration; cached agents/last-success/error count; failures keep loop running.

capabilities.title: State diff
capabilities.expectation: Signature status/title/cwd/type/sessionPath; appeared/status/disappeared; metadata changes may emit status same from/to.

capabilities.title: Initial observation
capabilities.expectation: Suppress appeared while previous map empty; disappearance retains last identity for notification.

capabilities.title: Event journal
capabilities.expectation: Memory only; monotonic IDs from 1; capacity 500; oldest evicted; restart loses journal; C11 adds byte cap + heartbeat.

capabilities.title: SSE catch-up
capabilities.expectation: Last-Event-ID replay; unknown/future/legacy → resync at current boundary; max 8 streams; C11 epoch IDs.

capabilities.title: Push trigger
capabilities.expectation: working→any other status; working/blocked→gone; idle/done disappearance ignored; watcher failure ≠ mass disappearance.

capabilities.title: Push wording and deep links
capabilities.expectation: 'Agent needs you' / 'Agent finished' / 'Agent stopped'; grounded identity; waiting/done/gone tags; /#/agent/<encoded paneId>.

capabilities.title: Subscription lifecycle
capabilities.expectation: Endpoint-keyed upsert; remove endpoint; persistent VAPID key generation or env override; serialized store ops; C14 atomic store.

capabilities.title: Delivery
capabilities.expectation: Encrypted Web Push; TTL 60 s; 404/410 prune expired; other failures logged; push failure never fails watcher.

capabilities.title: Legacy-store migration
capabilities.expectation: On startup copy old cwd .herdr-remote/push.json incl. keys when old has subscriptions and destination absent/empty; never overwrite populated destination.

capabilities.title: Personal tailnet trust boundary
capabilities.expectation: No app auth/cookies/per-device permissions; network ACLs/Serve remain the access boundary.

capabilities.title: Mutation origin policy
capabilities.expectation: Exact configured origins + loopback localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 any port; missing Origin rejected; no general CORS middleware.

capabilities.title: Body guards
capabilities.expectation: JSON Content-Type; declared Content-Length >64 KiB rejected pre-parse (kept) AND streamed byte limit enforced (C09); prompt ≤32 KiB UTF-8.

capabilities.title: Session confinement
capabilities.expectation: Canonical configured roots; path segment checks; symlink escape rejection; missing root/file vs outside-root/link distinguished; C13 descriptor-based confinement.

capabilities.title: File roots
capabilities.expectation: Project roots from fresh Herdr snapshot + configured extra roots per request; no implicit Desktop/Downloads/Pictures.

capabilities.title: File descriptor checks
capabilities.expectation: Canonicalize roots/target; open resolved; fstat regular+size; read same descriptor; close; 12 MiB max; C13 revalidation.

capabilities.title: Inline/download policy
capabilities.expectation: Inline .avif .gif .jpeg .jpg .png .webp .pdf; text/plain for .txt .log .json .jsonl .md .diff .patch; others octet-stream attachment; SVG never inline.

capabilities.title: Recent-image discovery
capabilities.expectation: png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/avif; recursive depth 3; cap 400 collected; 120 per directory; 4 roots concurrently; most-recent first; return 60; C13 global budget ownership.

capabilities.title: Scan exclusions/degradation
capabilities.expectation: Dot entries and dependency/build dirs skipped; unreadable/disappeared ignored; stat follows links; partial scan normal without completeness field.

capabilities.title: Error response contract
capabilities.expectation: Named cause/hint; structured response validation before emission; outgoing ≥400 logged; C04 removes error swallows.

capabilities.title: Log format
capabilities.expectation: ISO time [LEVEL] [source] message + optional JSON detail truncated 2000 chars; server/client origins; file path injectable.

capabilities.title: Log bounds
capabilities.expectation: Rotate >4 MiB current to .1; suppress repeats key path/source/level/message in rolling 60 s; repeat counter made truthful (was promised, not emitted); sink failure surfaces to stderr.

capabilities.title: Display error sanitization
capabilities.expectation: Human detail preferred; replace pane/tab IDs in suitable strings; fallback serialization ≤300 chars.

capabilities.title: Read-only upstream data
capabilities.expectation: No prompt experiments on user agents; fake socket transport/temp stores only; service mutations only from explicit product actions.

knownDefects.fact: Codex fallback state DBs sorted reverse-lexically while comments claim highest version first
Unresolvable published slot falls through to title fallback without evidence trail
Dedup matches any retained fingerprint inside the window (A→B→A suppressed), comment says consecutive
Concurrent check/send/update not atomic; unknown transport reported as sent
agent_prompted discriminator not checked: success record confirms without evidence
Trust service state omitted from response; contract failure turns service outcomes into 500
Args validated after tab creation; LaunchFailed phase/pane flattened into error string
Generated-name fallback after 99 tries can return a taken -1 name
'available' decoded but never used; list endpoint does not mirror launch state filter
SQLite cursor identifies neither database, agent nor session; never reports rotation reset
Partial trailing bytes double-counted in summary cache identity
Resync construction may replay retained events in the same iteration; future cursor after restart not a discontinuity
Idle canceled SSE loop stays alive; stream count freed but loop persists
Repeat suppression advertises counts it never emits
Only declared Content-Length enforced; streamed chunked bodies unlimited
Shared 400-array across concurrent collectors; per-directory counter per walk invocation, no atomic budget
Canonicalize-then-open is not descriptor-relative; concurrent symlink swap unguarded
Some handlers collapse detailed causes; incremental read errors can become empty success
Tailnet check accepts '100.'/'fd7a:' string prefixes instead of parsed ranges
Notification text generation has no unmeasured fallback; identity may be lost on push race
Summary timestamps numeric milliseconds; message timestamps may be source ISO strings
provider accepted in LaunchAgentRequest but never consumed — must remain explicitly not applied
